items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Warren told me, say, listen buddy, that's a good waltz, he said, but let's see. So he played it.

ctx.x: Thank you. Warren told me, say, listen buddy, that's a good waltz, he said, but let's see. So he played it. And he played it different. Sounded good though, but it still wasn't like mine. And Jim Fisher the same. But they heard me play it, you know, and then they, of course I used to play plenty then, but I left it long, I haven't played piano I guess, almost 50 years, I haven't fooled with piano. Around 50 years. Sometime I might sit down and play, when people come in they ask me to play, you know, I'll play,…
And this blues you played before, do you have a name for it?
